imageurl.title: ABHA Creation & Verification
imageurl.description: Implemented ABDM-compliant ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) creation, authentication, and verification workflows using Spring Boot APIs for seamless digital health identity management.

imageurl.title: React Native Health App Integration
imageurl.description: Integrated ABDM services into a React Native mobile application, enabling users to manage digital health identities and access healthcare services directly from mobile devices.

imageurl.title: Health Record Linking
imageurl.description: Developed secure APIs for linking patient health records with ABHA accounts, ensuring interoperability and seamless access to healthcare information across systems.

imageurl.title: Consent-Based Data Sharing
imageurl.description: Implemented ABDM consent management workflows, allowing patients to securely grant, manage, and revoke access to their health records while maintaining full control over personal data.

imageurl.title: Spring Boot Healthcare APIs
imageurl.description: Designed and developed scalable Spring Boot microservices for ABDM integration, ensuring reliable communication between healthcare providers and national digital health infrastructure.

imageurl.title: Security, Privacy & Compliance
imageurl.description: Implemented secure authentication, encrypted data exchange, auditability, and ABDM-compliant workflows to protect sensitive healthcare information and ensure regulatory compliance.

description: A large-scale Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) integration project developed at Jescon Technologies Pvt Ltd. The platform leverages Spring Boot microservices and React Native mobile applications to enable ABHA creation, health record linking, consent-driven data sharing, and secure interoperability across healthcare systems. Built with a strong focus on privacy, security, compliance, and scalable digital health infrastructure, contributing to India's national healthcare digitization initiative.
